title: Best Astoria Lighting Alternatives in 2026 (Ranked)
body_markdown:
Astoria Lighting popularized the idea of a permanent, app-controlled roofline lighting system that stays up year-round instead of getting hung and taken down every winter — that part of the pitch is real and it changed the category. The ceiling shows up once you need a single local point of accountability for installation and repairs, or you want lighting paired with gutter work on the same roofline in one visit. **The best Astoria Lighting alternative in 2026 is CleanGutters Lighting if you're in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and want an owner-installed system; Trimlight if you want the widest national franchise footprint; Gemstone Lighting if color-changing app control is the top priority.**


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners who want one crew handling lighting and gutters.
- Astoria Lighting alternatives split into national franchise networks (Trimlight) and app-first smart systems (Gemstone Lighting).
- Quality on any franchise-model permanent lighting brand depends on the local installer, not just the brand name.
- CleanGutters Lighting has installed roofline lighting and gutter systems since 2009, with 1,000+ homes served in the region.




## Why this matters

Permanent roofline lighting is a category built on franchise and dealer networks — Astoria Lighting, Trimlight, and Gemstone Lighting all sell through local installers rather than one centralized crew. That structure means the brand name on the website tells you less than who actually shows up with a ladder in your neighborhood.

If your Astoria Lighting quote came back thin on service-area detail, warranty transfer terms, or who handles repairs after year one, you're not imagining a gap — it's a known feature of how these networks operate. The comparison below focuses on what a homeowner can actually verify before signing: installer model, control app, and what happens when a section stops lighting up in year three.

## Astoria Lighting alternatives at a glance

| System | Best for | Standout feature | How it differs from Astoria Lighting |
|---|---|---|---|
| Astoria Lighting | Homeowners already inside its dealer network | National brand recognition | Baseline for this comparison |
| [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) | South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners wanting one crew for lighting and gutters | Owner-installed roofline lighting, no subcontractors | Regional-only, single point of contact from quote to repair |
| Trimlight | Homeowners who want the broadest national dealer network | Widest geographic coverage | Franchise model similar to Astoria Lighting, more locations to choose from |
| Gemstone Lighting | Homeowners prioritizing color-changing app control | Deep smart home and app integration | Focused on lighting only, no combined gutter service |

## 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for owner-installed permanent lighting

CleanGutters Lighting installs custom architectural roofline LED lighting across South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware, and the person who quotes the job is the same person who runs the crew. That matters more in this category than in most home services, because permanent lighting failures usually trace back to inconsistent installation, not the LED hardware itself.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines:**
- Same installer handles lighting and gutter protection, so rooflines get measured once instead of by two separate crews
- No subcontractor layer between the homeowner and the person doing the work
- Local service area means faster response for adjustments or repairs after install

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short:**
- Service area is limited to South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware — not an option outside that region
- Smaller company means less brand recognition than a national franchise name

**Best for:** homeowners in the tri-state coverage area who want lighting and gutter work handled by the same team.

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Astoria Lighting |
|---|---|---|
| Installer model | Owner-installed, no subcontractors | Franchise/dealer network |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern Delaware | Varies by dealer territory |
| Combined gutter service | Yes | No |
| Years in market | Since 2009 | Varies by franchise territory |

**Verdict: Buy** if you're inside the coverage area and want lighting and gutters handled together.

## 2. Trimlight: best for national franchise coverage

Trimlight runs one of the largest dealer networks in permanent lighting, which makes it the practical pick for homeowners outside CleanGutters Lighting's South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware footprint. A full breakdown of how it stacks up against other Astoria Lighting alternatives lives in the [Trimlight alternatives comparison](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-trimlight-alternatives).

**Where Trimlight shines:**
- Dealer count gives it the widest reach of any brand in this comparison
- Established track record as one of the original permanent lighting franchises

**Where Trimlight falls short:**
- Installation quality varies by local dealer, the same structural issue as Astoria Lighting
- Gutter protection and lighting are handled as separate services, not one crew

**Best for:** homeowners outside the South Jersey / Eastern PA / Northern Delaware region who want a large, established dealer network.

| Dimension | Trimlight | Astoria Lighting |
|---|---|---|
| Dealer network size | Large, national | Regional/franchise-dependent |
| Installer consistency | Varies by dealer | Varies by dealer |
| Combined gutter service | No | No |

**Verdict: Hold** as a strong option if you're outside CleanGutters Lighting's service area — compare local dealer reviews before committing either way.

## 3. Gemstone Lighting: best for app-controlled color-changing systems

Gemstone Lighting leans hardest into the smart home angle of permanent lighting — color-changing scenes, scheduling, and remote app control are the centerpiece of the pitch. A ranked look at how different systems handle app control sits in the [permanent lighting app control comparison](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/permanent-lighting-systems-ranked-by-app-control-features).

**Where Gemstone Lighting shines:**
- App-first design with deep scene and scheduling control
- Strong fit for homeowners who already run a smart home ecosystem

**Where Gemstone Lighting falls short:**
- Lighting-only focus means no gutter protection bundled into the same visit
- App-dependent features add a layer of complexity some homeowners don't want

**Best for:** homeowners who want the deepest smart-home integration and don't need gutter work handled at the same time.

| Dimension | Gemstone Lighting | Astoria Lighting |
|---|---|---|
| App control depth | Deep, scene-based | Standard app control |
| Combined gutter service | No | No |
| Installer model | Dealer network | Dealer network |

**Verdict: Buy** if smart home integration is the deciding factor and gutter service isn't part of the ask.

## Why people switch from Astoria Lighting

- **They want one crew, not two.** Franchise lighting networks handle lighting only — gutters, fascia, and roofline protection go to a separate contractor.
- **They want to know who's actually installing.** Dealer and franchise models mean the installer isn't always the person who sold the job.
- **They're outside the strongest dealer territory.** Coverage and response times vary by franchise region, which pushes some homeowners toward a local, single-owner installer instead.

**[Get a quote](https://cleangutterslighting.com/)**


## When staying with Astoria Lighting is the right call

If your Astoria Lighting system is already installed, under warranty, and working, switching brands solves nothing — a working system isn't a problem to fix. Staying also makes sense if you're outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware, since CleanGutters Lighting can't service that installation directly.

## FAQ


**What is the best Astoria Lighting alternative in 2026?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the best Astoria Lighting alternative for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners who want lighting and gutter work from one installer. Trimlight and Gemstone Lighting are stronger picks outside that region or for deeper app control.

**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Astoria Lighting?**

CleanGutters Lighting offers owner-installed service with no subcontractors inside its South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware coverage area, while Astoria Lighting operates through a dealer network. Neither is universally better — the right pick depends on your location and whether you want gutter service bundled in.

**Does permanent lighting quality depend on the brand or the installer?**

Installer consistency matters more than brand name in this category, since Astoria Lighting, Trimlight, and Gemstone Lighting all sell through local dealers or franchises. Ask who is physically doing the install, not just which brand is on the quote.

**Can permanent lighting be paired with gutter guard installation?**

Yes, CleanGutters Lighting installs roofline LED lighting alongside micro-mesh gutter guard systems in the same visit across its South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware service area. Most franchise lighting brands, including Astoria Lighting and Gemstone Lighting, handle lighting separately from gutter work.

**What should I check before switching from Astoria Lighting?**

Check whether your existing warranty transfers, confirm the new installer's actual service area, and ask who handles repairs after the first year. These three details matter more than brand comparisons alone.

**Is Trimlight a good Astoria Lighting alternative?**

Trimlight is a strong option if you're outside CleanGutters Lighting's South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware footprint and want one of the largest national dealer networks. Compare local dealer reviews since installation quality varies by territory.


## One last thing

The detail most homeowners skip when comparing Astoria Lighting alternatives is warranty transferability — not whether a warranty exists, but whether it moves with the house when it sells. CleanGutters Lighting's gutter guard warranties are built to transfer, and that same question is worth asking of any lighting installer before signing, franchise or not.
